project_type: APIA - a portable GitHub Copilot skill package (off-model deterministic Python scripts + prompts/agents/skills) that runs entirely on the user's Copilot session, never calling an external LLM. Phase 6a adds LOCAL, git-based knowledge & capability sharing (four capabilities) and explicitly DROPS the former Phase-6b external/hosted platform.
language: Python 3.9 (stdlib + optional PyYAML); C++ sample projects (CMake + GoogleTest + CTest) exercised by the C++ adapter.
build_system: No app build; deliverables are Python scripts under .apia/scripts/. C++ e2e tests build GoogleTest via CMake in real time. Local venv at /projects/sandbox/.venv.
test_framework: pytest. Tests in .apia/scripts/tests/. 296 existing tests MUST stay green. C++ e2e tests build live and are slow (full suite ~255s and growing).
test_command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest .apia/scripts/tests/ -q  (ALWAYS use timeout >= 600000 ms; C++ e2e builds GoogleTest live)
verification_instructions: 1) py_compile all scripts. 2) full pytest suite with >=600000ms timeout; all 296 existing + new tests green. 3) FOR REAL: round-trip a knowledge pack (ingest sample -> export -> import into fresh copy -> assert artifacts/project-facts match AND a local correction is NOT clobbered); apply an org profile and assert config precedence (profile applies, local override wins); load a sample LOCAL plugin (adapter + scanner, shape if feasible) and assert ingest/scan/scaffold/verify discover+use it, incl. a malformed-plugin graceful-failure case; generate the capability manifest and assert it reports python=complete, cpp=complete, csharp/groovy=stub, scanners, shapes, plugins, versions. Do this for Python and C++ where relevant. 4) keep the no-LLM/no-network guard tests green (add one for the new module).
snapshot_or_generated_files: none checked in for this task beyond intentional committable example artifacts under .apia/ (e.g. a sample plugin + a shared profile example) if added. Do NOT commit .agents/, .kiro*, APIA/, or free-floating .tasks/*review*.md transcripts.
setup_instructions: source /projects/sandbox/.venv/bin/activate (python3.9 + pytest + PyYAML; bandit/ruff/radon/pip-audit/flake8; cppcheck/clang-tidy; cmake/g++/ctest; Flask). Network OPEN.
environment_constraints: Network OPEN but the off-model scripts make NO network/LLM calls (every script carries a no-network/no-LLM guard test). C++ e2e tests build GoogleTest live => always run pytest with timeout >= 600000 ms or it appears to hang at the 120s default. Phase 6a is fully deterministic/off-model, so ALL of its mechanics are genuinely executable in-sandbox (no worked-example needed).
contribution_requirements: Keep APIA founding constraints: runs entirely on the user's Copilot session; NEVER calls a separate/external LLM; zero network/LLM calls in the off-model scripts; strictly LOCAL (no server, no network service, no auth/multi-tenancy, nothing leaves the machine); sharing is VIA THE GIT REPO (committed files) exactly like .apia/knowledge/; token/credit efficient; semi-autonomous + human-gated. Match the existing concise technical tone and schema/contract conventions. Tier-0 .github/copilot-instructions.md currently 6362 bytes against a ~6500-byte ceiling: add the sharing capability VERY concisely (defer detail to the prompt/skill) or tighten existing prose. VS 2022 honors only Tier-0 + Tier-1 prompts, so the sharing capability must be usable by a single agent via the prompt/Tier-0.
key_patterns: REPO-FIRST config resolution everywhere: the target repo's .apia/config.yml wins, then the APIA package config is the fallback (see scan._config_stacks / scaffold._load_config / evalloop._load_config). REUSABLE functions to build on, DO NOT duplicate: ingest.doctor(tools,repo_path,required_categories) + ingest.format_doctor_report(report) + ingest.ARTIFACTS (the 8 knowledge artifacts incl. project-facts.md) + ingest.INDEX_FILE('.index.json') + ingest.detect_stacks/walk_repo + ingest.default_knowledge_dir(); scan.load_adapter(path), scan._config_stacks(repo), scan._adapter_path_for_stack(name,repo), scan.detect_stack_and_adapter(repo), scan.scanner_tools_report(adapter), scan.apply_thresholds, scan.load_review_config; scaffold.resolve_supported_shapes(repo) + scaffold._load_config(repo) + SUPPORTED_SHAPES; verify.load_adapter(path). Adapters: python.yml + cpp.yml complete (have scanners:/generate: sections); csharp.yml + groovy.yml are stubs (test_command: null, no scanners:). Each off-model script has a static no-network/no-LLM guard test (forbidden-substring tripwire) in its test file - replicate for the new module. CLI convention: argparse with a mutually-exclusive action group + shared options (--repo, --json), --doctor on every script, __main__ exits with the function's return code.
relevant_files: .apia/scripts/share.py (NEW off-model module: knowledge-pack export/import, org/team profile apply, local plugin discovery/load, capability manifest - all REUSING the functions above). CLI: --export-pack/--import-pack/--apply-profile/--manifest/--plugins/--doctor + --json.
